# Industry adaptability

## Progressive deployment and expansion

| Implementation principles | Normative note |
| --- | --- |
| Retain existing system | Access to authorized data and processes can be provided while existing business systems are maintained |
| Start with a single scene. | You can first select a single scenario with clear and validated boundaries. |
| Phased expansion | Extension to other sectors, processes or intelligent body scenes based on actual usage |
| Commerce and delivery boundary | Options, authorizations, interfaces, implementation, prices and range of services are based on approved options and contracts |
